delete.title: Delete account
delete.pendingBody: Your account is scheduled for deletion on {date}. You can cancel anytime before then.
delete.warning: You can delete your account at any time. We'll keep a 7-day grace window so you can undo from the confirmation email if you change your mind. After that, your data is anonymized and uploaded photos are purged.
delete.confirmTitle: This will schedule your account for deletion.
delete.couldNotCancel: Could not cancel the deletion. Try again.

forbidden.title: Access denied

forbidden.signInDifferent: Sign in with a different account

offline.title: You are offline
offline.description: We could not reach the network. Some cached pages may still be available; otherwise check your connection and try again.

eraseCancel.noTokenBody: This page expects a one-time token from the confirmation email. Open the email and click the undo link directly.
eraseCancel.okBody: Your account deletion request has been cancelled. No further action is needed — you can close this tab.
eraseCancel.fallback: We could not cancel the deletion. Try again or contact support.
